highlights.title: Routine runs you said no to look calm
highlights.text: In a routine's History, a run you said no to now reads "You said no" in grey instead of a rose "A step failed". A real failure still shows rose.

highlights.title: File steps show the whole path
highlights.text: In a reply's Details, a step where the bot read or edited a file now opens to show the file's full path, so you can see exactly which file it touched.

fixes: A step the bot asked you to do reads "You did it", "Cleared by itself", "You said no" or "Asked you" once it's over.
A bot that runs your home and other tools isn't sent back to redo a home step when it truthfully says it did something else.
A bot that claims a home change it never made is caught from the first message, even before Home Assistant is tested.
"You said no" shows only after a real Deny; an unanswered card, a timed-out wait or kwant's own block now says what happened.
A step the bot asked you to do that nobody finished in time shows an amber "Not done in time" instead of Done.
Opening the bot browser panel shows the bot's own newest page, and the pane no longer jumps while its page tabs load.
Picking another tab in the bot browser shows its address right away, never the last tab's or another bot's.
In Details, each command you were asked about is one row, saying "You said no" or "Not approved in time" right on it.
A reply's step count matches the rows in its Details: a command and your answer to it count as one step, not two.
An empty tab in the bot browser keeps its address field empty, and its title follows the tab you pick.
When kwant blocks a push, that push's own step says so, and another call failing at the same time keeps its own error.
What you type in the bot browser's address field stays while the page updates, and a tab you go back to shows its newest address.
A page you pick in the bot browser panel keeps its own address bar but no longer changes which page the bot thinks it is on.
On a phone, a reply's step summary wraps to a second line instead of being cut off, and counts steps like the live count.
Plus 10 more fixes: kwant.si's "New in 0.9.26" lists them all.
